_comment: IWA Starknet MAINNET deployment configuration. Working copy — not a template. Two values are deliberately unset and must be supplied by the project owner before anything can run; the validator rejects the placeholders, so this file cannot deploy as it stands.
_verified: network, pool, USDC and STRK were re-verified read-only against SN_MAIN on 2026-08-29. Re-run `./iwa-deploy.sh validate deploy.config.json` immediately before deploying.
_privacy_pool: VERIFIED. StarkWare STRK20 privacy pool. class 0x67dddd89d80fedadc06b6f160798f94800a4a70164e5a24301cd0d6076b554d, get_version()=0x322e30 ('2.0'), answers is_open_note_depositor_blocked. IWA integrates with this and must NEVER declare or deploy it.
_usdc_token: VERIFIED. Circle native USDC on Starknet. symbol=USDC, decimals=6. NOT bridged USDC.e (0x053c91253bc9682c04929ca02ed00b3e423f6710d2ee7e0d5ebb06f3ecf368a8).
_strk_token: VERIFIED. symbol=STRK, decimals=18, name='Starknet Token'. Also the token the pool collects its fee in.
_surplus_sink: OWNER INPUT REQUIRED. Immutable 5th constructor argument of IwaStrk20Helper; there is no setter and no admin. Receives unaccounted tokens sent to the helper, moved only by the permissionless normalize_surplus. Must be a dedicated IWA Starknet treasury multisig. Must NOT be: the setup authority / deployer, the privacy pool, USDC, STRK, the deployed IwaCircle, or the helper itself. Choosing this wrongly cannot be corrected after deployment.
_setup_authority: OWNER INPUT REQUIRED. The funded Starknet deployer account address. Its only power is calling initialize_settlement_helper exactly once; IwaCircle clears it to zero in that same call. Temporary by construction.
_deployer_account: OWNER INPUT REQUIRED. The sncast account NAME (from `sncast account list`) that signs declare/deploy/invoke. Must correspond to the same address given as setup_authority, and must hold STRK for gas.
